notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1945. Curated; dated by the page footers (m/d/yy) and the meeting openers.

coverage.remaining: War-years repair contracts, wartime uses of parks, and works with no page (Sutro Heights diorama house, the Golden Gate Park orchid house, Bufano statues at Aquatic Park) not placed.

findings.description: The architect Lewis P. Hobart presented preliminary plans for modernizing the Sharon Building in the Children's Quarters, and the Board of Park Commissioners sent them to the park staff for comment.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, April 12, 1945

resolution.method: A named park, playground or park building placed on its Recreation and Park place page by the name and streets the minutes give.
